title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Apply practical, applied machine learning thinking. Tests algorithm selection, model evaluation, and bias detection.

seo.overviewBody: Predictive analytics allows organizations to forecast future business trends. Data analysts demonstrate machine learning competence by training supervised models (Scikit-Learn), evaluating regression/classification algorithms, and assessing model performance.

deliverables.title: 1. Predictive Machine Learning Notebook
deliverables.desc: Jupyter Notebook training linear regression, decision tree, or random forest models on tabular data.

deliverables.title: 2. Feature Engineering & Selection Log
deliverables.desc: Document detailing feature encoding, numerical scaling (StandardScaler), and correlation selection.

deliverables.title: 3. Model Performance Evaluation Report
deliverables.desc: Evaluation report presenting confusion matrices, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC metrics.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Overfitting and Underfitting?
faqs.answer: Overfitting occurs when a model learns training data noise and fails to generalize to new data. Underfitting occurs when a model is too simple to capture underlying data patterns.

faqs.question: When should you prioritize Precision over Recall?
faqs.answer: Prioritize Precision when false positives are costly (e.g. spam detection). Prioritize Recall when false negatives are dangerous (e.g. disease screening).

faqs.question: Why is a train-test split necessary?
faqs.answer: Splitting data into separate training (e.g. 80%) and testing (e.g. 20%) sets allows you to evaluate how well the model generalizes to unseen data.
